items.headline: Freshman and 3rd-string QB Levi Davis scores winner in 3rd OT in Ohio's 29-27 victory
items.description: — Freshman and third-string quarterback Levi Davis ran for a 2-point conversion in the third overtime to give Ohio a 29-27 victory over Jacksonville State on Saturday night.

items.headline: Anthony Colandrea accounts for 4 TDs as Nebraska pulls away in 4th quarter to beat Ohio 49-21
items.description: — Anthony Colandrea passed for 275 yards with three touchdowns and ran for a fourth, Jamal Rule ran for 122 yards and scored three times, and Nebraska pulled away from Ohio in the fourth quarter in a 49-21 victory on Saturday.
